summary: The root Q-T-L, beyond its common meaning of "to kill," can also mean "to know something thoroughly." It implies a deep, complete understanding, as if one has mastered the knowledge of that thing.
lane: 1 قَتَلَ الشَّىْءَ ذ , inf. n. قَتْلٌ , (assumed tropical:) He knew the thing; he was, or became, acquainted with it: (Msb:) [or rather, i. q. ] قَتَلَهُ عِلْمًا , (Bd in iv. 156, and TA,) and خُبْرًا , (K,) and بِعِلْمِهِ , (Bd, ubi supra,) he knew it (Bd, K, TA) completely, (TA,) or thoroughly, very well, or superlatively well; as also نَحَرَهُ عِلْمًا . (Bd.) See أَثْبَتَ الشَّىْء مَعْرِفَةً in art. ثبت .

headwords.gloss: He fought; combated, him; contended with him in fight; conflict

parts.t: combated, him; contended with him in fight

headwords.def: قَاتَلَهُ He fought, or combated, him; contended with him in fight or conflict or battle. قَاتَلَ عَلَى دِيِن ٱللّٰهِ : see 3 in art. ازى .
تَقَتَّلَتْ لَهُ means تَخَضَّعَتْ لَهُ وَتَذَلَّلَتْ حَتَّى عَشِقَهَا . (A.)

headwords.gloss: He sought; courted, slaughter; i. q

parts.t: he resigned and subjected himself to slaughter, and cared not for death.

headwords.def: اِسْتَقْتَلَ [properly He sought, or courted, slaughter; ] i. q. اِسْتَمَاتَ ; (S, K;) meaning he cared not for death, by reason of his courage; (JM;) he resigned and subjected himself to slaughter, and cared not for death. (Mgh.)

headwords.gloss: Murderous; slaughterous; very deadly; A very deadly serpent
headwords.def: قَتَّالٌ [ Murderous; slaughterous; very deadly. ] You say حَيَّةٌ قَتَّالَهٌ [ A very deadly serpent ]. (TA in art. اصل .)

;) and to poison. (TA in that art.)

headwords.def: قَاتِلٌ Deadly; applied to a tree; (K in art. خمط ;) and to poison. (TA in that art.)

headwords.gloss: vital; place; where a wound causes death

parts.t: in a man [or an animal, i. e.]

headwords.def: مَقْتَلٌ A [ vital ] place in a man [or an animal, i. e.] where a wound causes death; (S, Msb;) as the temple: (Msb:) pl. مَقَاتِلُ . (S.)
وَلِنِّى مَقَاتِلَكَ means حَوِّلْ إِلَىَّ وَجْهَكَ . (A.)
